2116630555135517067.en_summary: BREAKING: The US personal savings rate fell -0.2 percentage points in September, to 4.2%, its lowest level since October 2022. Since January 2024, this metric has declined -3.4 percentage points. The personal savings rate is now well below the 5-year pre-pandemic average of 6.2%. Personal income grew +4.1% YoY in September, its 2nd-lowest growth rate since April 2022. Personal consumption expenditures rose +6.3% YoY, the 2nd-highest YoY growth since December 2024. Consumer spending continues to outpace income growth, putting further pressure on household savings and increasing household reliance on borrowing. Elevated inflation and record prices are putting further pressure on consumer savings.
2116630555135517067.zh_summary: 突發：美國個人儲蓄率在9月下降0.2個百分點，至4.2%，為2022年10月以來最低水平。自2024年1月以來，該指標已下降3.4個百分點。個人儲蓄率現已遠低於疫情前5年平均的6.2%。個人收入在9月同比增長4.1%，為2022年4月以來第二低增長率。個人消費支出同比上升6.3%，為2024年12月以來第二高同比增長。消費者支出持續超過收入增長，進一步對家庭儲蓄造成壓力，並增加家庭對借貸的依賴。高通脹和創紀錄價格進一步對消費者儲蓄造成壓力。

2116627869841670383.en_summary: (Reposted by @TaviCosta) Gold’s 30% Drop Matches 2008, but a Bottom Is Near | Tavi Costa. Taken as one sector, #gold miners would have the cleanest balance sheets in the stock market, says Tavi Costa @TaviCosta , yet mining makes up less than 1% of it. The founder and CEO of Azuria Capital calls this pullback “one of the most compelling windows of opportunities” he has seen this cycle, and with gold down about 30% by his count, he thinks “we’re closer to the bottom.” Costa points to free cash flow yields near 10% and bank models that still value the miners on $3,000 to $3,500 gold. Plug in a higher long-term price, he argues, and the whole industry gets re-rated. He is especially drawn to silver miners, some holding 10% to 15% of their market cap in cash, and he sees resources as the new moat in a world AI can disrupt, calling mining “the best AI trade.”
2116627869841670383.zh_summary: （由@TaviCosta轉發）黃金下跌30%與2008年相符，但底部已近｜Tavi Costa。作為一個板塊，#黃金礦商將擁有股市中最乾淨的資產負債表，Tavi Costa @TaviCosta表示，但礦業僅佔其中不到1%。Azuria Capital創辦人兼行政總裁稱這次回調為「他在這個週期中見過的最引人注目的機會窗口之一」，按他計算黃金下跌約30%，他認為「我們更接近底部」。Costa指出自由現金流收益率接近10%，銀行模型仍以3000至3500美元的黃金價格估值礦商。他認為若代入更高的長期價格，整個行業將重新評級。他特別看好白銀礦商，一些持有其市值10%至15%的現金，他視資源為人工智能可能干擾的世界中的新護城河，稱礦業為「最佳人工智能交易」。
